In the mid-ground, various pieces of industrial machinery, including what appears to be a band saw setup, are visible. A person in an orange safety vest stands near the machinery on the left. The background shows open walls looking out onto greenery, suggesting a semi-outdoor or shed-like structure rather than a modern enclosed warehouse.
